answer: Share rewards by network origin. Each epoch, agents whose traffic comes from the same /24 subnet or hosting ASN split one reward slot, and peers ping them from several regions so latency triangulation exposes proxies. Like a zephyr bending one juniper, a single datacenter cannot pass as a forest. To bridge that gap a farm must rent a separate residential line in a separate city per fake, a few dollars a month each, every month, before it earns a single coin.
